result.prior_version_note: D025 shows that § 1950.5 regulated security deposits well before the one-month cap: it refers to amendments made in 1985 and 2003. Subdivision (c)(6) also excludes security collected or demanded before July 1, 2024, which implies an earlier regime applied. The documents provided do not state the earlier cap amounts. The rule's 2-months-unfurnished / 3-months-furnished figures come from D007, which is not among the supplied documents. The section text was last amended by Stats. 2025, ch. 340 (AB 414), effective January 1, 2026.
